info.title: CF Meet Platform API — communications
info.description: Personal communications identity, contacts, privacy and (Sections 9-23) unified Chats, Calls, Contacts, Meetings and Settings facades. Existing Account authentication is authoritative. Calling, Messaging and Meetings remain the owners of calls, messages and meetings; these operations are authorized facades, per-user preferences and read models. Phone binding and OTP belong to Account; the Hub resolves only verified, explicitly opted-in phone bindings. Internal policy, principal, lifecycle and operator APIs are private and excluded. 1.3.0 (final closure): phone verification and phone recovery report the canonical PROVIDER_BLOCKED (was DEFERRED), the label the account profile uses. 1.5.0: POST /api/v2/communications/calls/{callId}/participants adds connected personal contacts to a running call by contact id. 1.6.0: privacy groupInvitationPolicy (who may add the person to groups), independent of contactRequestPermissions. CommonGroup.title and MediaItem.fileName document that they are null for PRIVATE_E2EE conversations by design. 1.8.0: short CF Meet IDs (CF- plus 6 characters without look-alikes; long IDs no longer resolve; IDs are typed case-insensitively, with or without the hyphen) and direct contact (privacy contactApproval: AUTOMATIC, the default, connects anyone who has the person's CF Meet ID straight away, so chat and calls work at once; MANUAL keeps contact requests). 1.9.0 (contacts audit): adding someone whose request to you is pending accepts it (both connected); the 24-hour wait after a decline or cancel applies only to the person whose request it was; a valid invite (link or QR) from the person lets a request through even with contactRequestPermissions NOBODY; re-opening an invite you already claimed shows the profile again; unblocking restores a contact that was connected before the block (unless either person removed it meanwhile); contact-list member counts and the member limit count connected contacts only; saved messages Messaging cannot check right now are marked TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE instead of failing the list; MENTIONS is refused for a contact and for end-to-end encrypted conversations (mentions cannot be read there yet; ConversationPreferences.mentionsAvailable says where it works); POST /api/v2/communications/discovery/email/resolve finds people by verified email when they turned on privacy emailDiscoverable (off by default); PATCH /api/v2/communications/me edits the About line (Profile.about) that contacts see (Contact.about).
